text:
maria: Quick sync — for the private deployment POC we need to validate jumpbox hardening + KMS access model. Can folks confirm RBAC change plan and audit retention? I'll be out in 2h, want blockers now. :eyes:
ash: Uploaded RBAC deltas to infra/rbac/jumpbox.yaml — minimal roles: jumpbox-user, jumpbox-admin. Link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/-/blob/main/rbac/jumpbox.yaml
luca: For KMS: we should prefer customer-managed HSM for on-prem. Key policy should bind to service principal 'svc/jumpbox' and to the admin group. Avoid wildcard principals.
tess: Netpol suggestion: deny-all egress, allow registry + kms + internal-api. Quick snippet:
```
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: jumpbox-egress
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: jumpbox
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 10.0.0.0/16
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          name: control-plane
```
ryan: Found one issue during vuln scan: jumpbox base image has CVE-2024-12345 (sshd privilege escalation). Recommend rebuild with patched image and force redeploy.
infra-oncall: Can schedule a maintenance window tonight 23:00-23:30 UTC. Will need approval for 1-yr audit retention and increased log volume.
maria: Approve window. For audit logs: security wants 1 year S3+WORM for infra events, 90 days for app-level traces. Need cost estimate.
security-bot: Reminder: KMS rotation due in 9 days for key 'redwood/priv-jumpbox'.
ash: On RBAC, one thing — we need a safe migration plan: create new roles, add members, run 7d monitoring, then remove old roles. I'll draft playbook.
luca: On HSM integration: test vector for access — we should use PKCS#11 + mTLS between jumpbox and key proxy. I'll add a minimal test harness.
tess: Also recommend adding egress allowlist enforcement at VPC NAT gateway level too — defense in depth.
ryan: I'll add CVE and patch task to triage board, assign to infra. tagging: #sev3
maria: Perfect. Follow-ups: ash please post RBAC diff PR, luca attach HSM test notes, infra-oncall confirm window in calendar. If anyone finds blocking vuln pre-window ping me @maria.
devops-bot: deploy-checklist: rbac-pr detected, required approvers: @ash @maria
infra-oncall: noted, will update calendar + ops-runbook with rollback steps.
security-bot: audit-policy update suggested: retain auth/audit logs 1yr w/ integrity hashes. Tagging @tess @luca for review.
ash: Will open the PR now. :rocket:
